name: Jamal Aurélie
japaneseName: ジャマル・オーレリー
description: Jamal Aurélie is an impetuous and fiercely devoted soldier of the Sacred Vollachia Empire, the older brother of Katya Aurélie, and the brother-in-law of Todd Fang. Rising from an ordinary infantryman to Low Count and Escort General, he played both antagonistic and supporting roles throughout Arc 7 and Arc 8.
